info.name: ReQurv Hive
info.summary: Private AI in your Nextcloud — chat, agents and MCP tools, powered by ReQurv AI Hive
info.description:
**ReQurv Hive** brings AI into your [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com) — private, self-hosted, and under your control. All model calls are served by [ReQurv AI Hive](https://hive.requrv.ai), ReQurv's private and secure OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint.
### Nextcloud App
- **Chat** — Converse with an AI assistant about your files and documents - **Projects** — Scope a conversation to selected folders, so the assistant only sees what you choose - **Coworkers** — Save repeatable AI jobs and run them on demand or on a schedule - **Summarise & rewrite** — Condense, draft, rephrase and proofread text - **Model picker** — Switch model per conversation - **Usage metrics** — Token and conversation counters exported via OpenMetrics
### AI provider
**ReQurv AI Hive** — OpenAI-compatible API hosted by ReQurv at hive.requrv.ai. The API key is configured once by the admin and stored encrypted; the base URL is an admin-only setting. Provider choice applies to chat and to the Nextcloud Assistant integrations alike. Assistant actions that send images need a vision-capable model.
### MCP Server
ReQurv Hive includes a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server with 316 tools that gives any MCP client — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Claude.ai and the Claude mobile app, Cursor, VS Code and others — direct access to your Nextcloud:
- **Files & sharing** — Browse, read, write, search, share, tag, and restore from trash or older versions - **Calendar, Tasks & Contacts** — Events, to-dos and address books over CalDAV and CardDAV, plus Deck boards and Projects - **Talk, Mail & Notifications** — Conversations, polls and reactions, mail accounts and messages, notification triage - **Photos & Maps** — Albums and metadata, GPS tracks and devices, favourites, and photo geotagging - **Notes, News, Recipes & Bookmarks** — Markdown notes, RSS feeds, recipes, and bookmark folders and tags - **Coworkers & administration** — Run saved AI jobs, manage users, groups and apps, run `occ`, and check integrity
### Resources
- [ReQurv AI Hive](https://hive.requrv.ai)
